name: halana_and_alena_counters_equal_power_haste_this_turn
notes: M5 mapper. Printed: 'At the beginning of combat on your turn, put X +1/+1 counters on another target creature you control, where X is Halana and Alena's power. That creature gains haste until end of turn.' Halana and Alena (2/3) carry two +1/+1 counters, so their power is 4. Seat 0 casts Bear Cub this turn; at the beginning of combat the trigger targets it: four counters (a 6/6) and haste, so the summoning-sick Bear Cub attacks for 6. On seat 1's turn the haste is gone; the counters stay.
